captions.title: Marketers, then Pay day
captions.line: It says how much is waiting to be paid out this month.

captions.title: Make this month's list
captions.line: One row per person, with the bank account to send it to.

captions.title: Copy the account number
captions.line: Send the transfer from your bank first, then record it here.

captions.title: Mark as paid, then the reference
captions.line: Whatever the transfer receipt calls it.

captions.title: Add the receipt
captions.line: The marketer sees it on their own screen.

captions.title: Record the payment
captions.line: Their row turns Paid, and the total sent goes up.

captions.title: Work down the list
captions.line: One transfer per person, recorded the same way.

captions.title: Watch the total climb
captions.line: Once nobody is left to pay, the button turns into Close this run.
